🚀 Welcome to the Inventory Kiosk!

This as a search engine for our inventory. Here is how to use it:

  • 🔍 How to Search: Just start typing in the "Search inventory" box. It will automatically filter the list.
  • ⚙️ The Settings Menu: Check the "Settings" box at the top to open the control panel. Inside, you can:
    • Export: Save what you see on the screen into a file you can open in Excel.
    • Pick Columns: Choose which info (like Location) you actually want to see.
  • 🔄 Switch Your View: Click the "Switch View" button to toggle between a Spreadsheet View and a List View.
  • ⚖️ Sorting: Click the top of any column check box to sort it from A-to-Z or 1-to-10.

Pro Tip: If you get lost, just click "Reset All Defaults" in the Settings to put everything back to normal!
